decision: D — NO PARAMETER-FREE SIGMA-CONSISTENT CONSTRUCTION EXISTS

covariance_proof_per_2x2_block.conclusion: No scalar maps the singular correlated nullspace law to iid N(0,I). The variance-only scale is therefore not sigma-consistent.

construction_analysis.replace_noise_with_noise_null: Changes the qualified Gaussian marginal and joint covariance.
construction_analysis.scale_noise_null: Requires renormalization and still cannot restore iid covariance.
construction_analysis.add_noise_null_to_control: Double-counts the existing null component and requires a detail-strength coefficient.
construction_analysis.retain_original_noise: Exactly reproduces control A and introduces no new discriminator.
